stages:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: nine background images for a Venezuelan 8-bit arcade fighting game.
Input references: Caracas/Altamira at sunset, Los Roques sea pier, Mérida cable-car mountains. Preserve the recognizable places and gameplay compositions but redraw them as beautiful authentic hand-placed 8-BIT PIXEL ART. Bold readable shapes, hard square pixels, flat 3-tone shading, selective 1-pixel outlines, 24-32 harmonious colors per scene, light orderly checker dithering only in shadow transitions. No painterly textures, soft gradients, smooth brushwork, 3D, blur or outlines that aren't aligned to a pixel grid.
Layout: exactly NINE distinct landscapes in a seamless 3 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS contact sheet, all equal 16:9 cells, no gaps, borders, labels, captions or numbers. Full sheet roughly 2304x1296 or greater if possible. Each tile is a side-on fighting arena background, flat open foreground across the bottom 15% for fighters, distant scenery in the upper 85%; no characters, no weapons, no floating platforms or UI.
Chronological row-major tile order:
TOP LEFT: Caracas / Plaza Altamira sunset. Tall slim obelisk a little left of center, Ávila green mountain silhouette, colorful apartment blocks, palms and plaza lamps at the sides, golden-orange sunset with geometric clouds, wide tiled plaza foreground.
TOP MIDDLE: La Guaira coastal malecón afternoon. Turquoise Caribbean sea, pastel colonial facades and green coastal mountain on left, wooden railing, boats far in the water, bright sky, flat seaside promenade foreground.
TOP RIGHT: Valencia historic plaza at night. Colonial yellow/ochre facades and white church silhouette, violet night sky, warm square-lit windows, trees and golden street lamps, open stone plaza foreground.
MIDDLE LEFT: Salto Ángel / Canaima morning. Huge flat-topped Auyantepui, exceptionally tall thin waterfall descending to lush jungle, emerald/teal green palette, big layered jungle leaves only at sides, mossy rock foreground.
MIDDLE MIDDLE: Lake Maracaibo sunset. Recognizable long Rafael Urdaneta bridge with angular tall cable towers crossing horizon, magenta-orange dusk, indigo lake and geometric reflections, clean maintenance pier foreground.
MIDDLE RIGHT: Mérida Andean cable-car mountains. Angular snowy mountains in cool blues, cable wires above and small yellow cable cabin with station on right, bright clouds, open stone terrace foreground.
BOTTOM LEFT: Médanos de Coro golden afternoon. Sweeping golden sand dunes with defined pixel stair-step curves, warm ochre, sparse cactus on sides, azure sky, broad flat sand foreground.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: Los Roques morning. Bright turquoise Caribbean reef and shallow transparent sea rendered in flat pixel bands, small colorful island fishing houses on left and palms on right, clean wooden pier foreground.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Poliedro de Caracas interior concert night. Recognizable dark geodesic dome roof overhead, violet/cyan/yellow stage lighting in geometric beams, distant audience in tiny square silhouettes, open dark concert stage foreground.
Make the 9 cells distinctly identifiable but consistent as one art collection. Charming, colorful and calm, with clean silhouette separation. Side-on camera and no tilted perspectives. Actual pixel artwork, avoid generating a photorealistic image merely with a pixel filter.
